doubts: Kind is one_way: the page's first heading gives one crossing (Lauder Station Road to Cluden Creek car park, 31 km = 6 + 18 + 7 km), with its legs as via; the other tracks have their own headings, distances and start and end, so they are listed as separate ways. Whether those separate tracks are offered as alternatives to the crossing is not stated. Whether the 4WD road passes Lauder Basin Hut is not stated (only that the sidle down to it is on the 4WD track), so it is not_on_route. Chain Hills Track is mentioned by a link to the Lindis Valley tracks page (L1); the ref is taken from that link. The gate from Cluden Creek car park onto Cluden Creek Track is locked and no key is available. No time is given for the whole crossing. The main way's start is not a feature on the map, so start and end carry no ref.
